support_spans: Six years earlier, she had undergone breast-conserving surgery with endocrine therapy and radiation (50 Gy in 25 fractions) to the left breast for an upper inner quadrant carcinoma.

contradict_spans: A core-needle biopsy of the lesion suggested only atrophic mammary glands.
candidates.why: The patient has a history of breast cancer and now presents with a new lump in the same breast.
